description: This file defines an interface 'AuthSchemeResolverInterface' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying a method for selecting the authentication scheme used for request signing.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolverInterface
classes.description: An interface that requires implementation of a method to select an authentication scheme for request signing.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects an authentication scheme for request signing based on a list of schemes and credentials.
